system.description:
Homesong helps keeps the hearth safe. When sung over a hearth, the master of the house knows everyone who enters (or tries to enter) his dwelling. Homesong is typically sung to greet guests returning home after a long journey.

Obstacle: See description. Cottage, Ob 1. Small house, Ob 2. Large house, Ob 3. Manor, Ob 4. Castle, Ob 5. Palace, Ob 6. Citadel, Ob 7.

Actions: 60

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 147
